question: The Udyogmandal Canal is a part of which National Waterways?
solution:
The correct answer is __**National Waterways 3**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **National Waterways 3:** 

 
 
• The West Coast Canal from Kottapuram to Kollam is declared as National Waterway No.3.
 
• From Kottapuram to Kollam including Champakara and Udyogmandal canals has a navigable length of 205 km. Hence, option 3 is correct. 
 
• This waterway comprises natural lakes, backwaters, river sections, and man-made canal sections.
 
• The Champakara and Udyogmandal canals link the industrial centers of Ambalamugal and Udyogmandal with the Kochi port.'
 
• On the main West Coast Canal between Kollam and Kottapuram, the Kochi Edapallikota (120 km) stretch was opened for cargo movement in November 1994.
 
•

• National Waterway 1 - Allahabad-Haldia stretch (1,620 km)
 
• National Waterway 2 - Sadiya-Dhubri stretch (891 km)
 
• National Waterway 4 - Kakinada-Puducherry canal stretch (767km) along with Godavari River stretch (171km) between (Bhadrachalam and Rajahmundry) and Krishna River stretch(157km) between (Wazirabad and Vijaywada) 
 
• National Waterway 5 - Canal stretch between Geonkhali and Charbatia (217 km), part of Matai River between Charbatia and Dhamra (40 km), part of Brahmani, Kharsua and Dhamra river system between Talcher and Dhamra (265 km), and Mahanadi delta river system between Mangalgadi and Paradeep (101 km).
